studentDocument.title: Electrochemical Energy Storage Challenges
studentDocument.text:
Renewable energy storage requires cost-effective and durable electrochemical systems for grid stabilization.

Lithium-ion batteries experience progressive capacity loss caused by solid electrolyte interphase layer growth on the graphite anode surface during prolonged charge-discharge cycling.

To mitigate degradation, alternative solid-state electrolytes are currently under intensive scientific investigation.
